title: Instrument record
description: One measurement instrument (survey, concept inventory, observation protocol, rubric, ...). Describes the instrument; never stores item text unless access.item_text_shareable is true.

id.description: Stable slug. Must match the file name. Never change after publishing.

pid.description: Persistent identifier, issued by scripts/assign_identifiers.py and recorded in identifiers.csv. Opaque, never changed, reassigned or deleted. See IDENTIFIERS.md. URI: https://w3id.org/humeta/instrument/<pid>.

participants.description: Who the instrument gathers data about, from the HuMeta participant_role vocabulary (the HuMeta profile's vocabularies.json), e.g. students, educators, community_members. For an observation protocol, the people observed.

description.description: What it measures and how, in the contributor's own words. Do not paste abstracts.

construct_ids.description: Constructs from constructs.json measured by the instrument as a whole.

construct_mapping.description: Review status of the mapping from this instrument (and its dimensions) to constructs. Mappings are provisional until the HuMeta governance committee approves them; researchers decide whether an instrument fits their own construct.

disciplines.description: From the HuMeta discipline vocabulary (ANZSRC FoR ids such as anzsrc_37, or discipline_general).

education_levels.description: Education levels the instrument has been used with, from the HuMeta education_level vocabulary (ISCED-based: primary, lower_secondary, upper_secondary, short_cycle_tertiary, bachelors, masters, doctoral, adult_education, informal_learning). May be empty for instruments not used in education.

settings.description: Where the instrument is used, from the HuMeta learning_environment vocabulary, e.g. postsecondary_classroom, k12_classroom, laboratory, museum_exhibit, online_course.

item_text_shareable.description: True only if the terms explicitly allow republishing items. Requires item_text_basis. The library still links rather than copies by default.

license.description: License the item text is released under in this library, e.g. 'CC BY 4.0', 'CC BY-NC-SA 3.0', 'Public domain'.

evidence.description: Where the permission is documented: license URL, developer statement URL, or a note that written permission is on file and with whom.

answer_key_shareable.description: Whether correct answers may be stored with item text. Separate from item text because public keys can weaken a test.

dimensions.description: Subscales, factors, concept categories, or code groups. Empty if the instrument is scored only as a whole.

info_sources.description: Pages the record's facts were taken from, so a reviewer can re-check them.

variable_prefix.description: Short prefix for generated variable names (e.g. 'gci' -> gci_q05). Must be unique across the library and never change once data exist.

metadata_code.description: Fixed measure part of HuMeta metadata codes (Construct_Measure_Item_Target): first author's surname and year of the original publication, e.g. Pintrich1991. A letter is added when two instruments would share a code (Smith2013a, Smith2013b). Unique across the library; never changes once published, even if the citation is corrected.

identifiers.description: Where this instrument is registered elsewhere, so HuMeta links to existing records instead of duplicating them. Order of preference: APA PsycTests DOI; a DOI from ZIS (GESIS), the Open Test Archive (ZPID) or FDZ Bildung (DIPF); a LOINC code (health instruments). Catalog pages without persistent identifiers (PhysPort, CHIRAL, AIR's edinstruments.org) and ERIC numbers are listed too.

status.description: needs_check: registries not yet fully searched (PsycTests needs a subscription to search). verified: a reviewer searched PsycTests and ZIS and the records below are complete.

checked.description: When the registries were last searched.

id.description: The registry's identifier: a DOI (PsycTests 10.1037/t#####-000, ZIS 10.6102/zis###), a LOINC code, or an ERIC number (ED######).

development.description: How the instrument was conceived. A theory is not required: many instruments are built from a definition of what to measure.

basis.description: theory = built from a named theory or framework; construct_definition = built from a definition of the construct, with no theory named; practical_need = built to answer a practical or instructional question; not_reported = the sources do not say.

framework_ids.description: Theories or frameworks in frameworks.json the instrument was built on.

theory_named.description: A theory not (yet) in the library, as named by the developers.

rubric_review.description: Rubric criteria met, as judged by a reviewer from the instrument's development and validation sources. Keys are rubric category ids.

source.description: Citation or link documenting the criteria.

commons_records.description: Deposits about this instrument in the STEMEd+ Commons Library, ideally one record in its HuMeta Instrument Library sub-collection holding the instrument, its manual, item and scoring files, and a paper where the license allows.

in_stemedplus_collection.description: true once the deposit has been approved into the HuMeta Instrument Library collection (or its parent, STEMEd+).

license.description: License chosen at deposit, e.g. CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 4.0, CC BY-NC 4.0, CC0, All rights reserved.

deposited_by_rights_holder.description: true when the depositor holds the rights (e.g. the developer), so the license applies to the deposited content.

contents.description: What the deposit holds when it bundles several files in one record (the recommended way).

developers.description: The instrument's developers, as named in its original citation. Exported as DataCite creators.

name.description: Family name, given names or initials (e.g. 'Libarkin, Julie C.').

pid.description: Persistent identifier of this version: the instrument's pid, a dot and HuMeta's version number (1 for the first version added, and so on; not the publisher's version name). See IDENTIFIERS.md.

code.description: Fixed version part of HuMeta metadata codes, joined to the instrument's metadata_code: Libarkin2005 + V4 = Libarkin2005V4. Item numbers differ between versions, so codes for items always say which version. Unique within the instrument; never changes once published. Version codes start with a capital letter (V1, V4, PhysV3, Chem).

language.description: BCP-47 tag, e.g. en, es, de.

form_type.description: fixed_form = everyone takes the same items. item_bank = users assemble subtests from a pool; item_count is the pool size.

subtest_length.description: For item banks: recommended number of items per subtest.

basis.description: empirical_factor = supported by factor analysis; design_category = content blueprint, not a validated subscale; coding_category = group of observation codes.

version_ids.description: Versions this dimension applies to. Omit if it applies to all.

needs_check.description: Open questions a reviewer must settle. Must be empty for source_verified.
